BNBPULSE.notes: BNB-themed fake investment platform (2125578.com); SPF: "masquerading as legitimate investment opportunities". Not a BNB Chain product.

Saudi Aramco.notes: Oil major name misused for fake "currency-oil" investment (currency-oil.com). aramco.com timed out to curl; domain from established knowledge.

INFO.notes: Tag never appears in the advisory text (about mineverse.cc crypto-mining scam); probably a word read off a screenshot. No identifiable brand. Human review suggested.

Compass Mining.notes: Real US bitcoin-mining hardware/hosting marketplace; SPF says scammers impersonate it (ssessoomm.com).

BNB.notes: BNB = native token of BNB Chain (Binance ecosystem). Fake BNB investment site bbconbnb.com. binance.com from established knowledge.

JoyBuy.notes: Joybuy = JD.com international e-commerce brand. Job-task scam (maill-top.net) uses its name.

GoMining.notes: Real bitcoin-mining platform; fake clone go-mining66.top. SPF wording leaves open whether GoMining itself is endorsed - treat as impersonated brand.

Nova Quant.notes: Fake quant-trading investment brand (novaxmr.xyz). Web search finds only unrelated hobby "NovaQuant" charting tools on pages.dev/netlify; no regulated firm.

A2.notes: "A2" investment-club brand (a2.mom). Web search shows NZ FMA repeatedly flagged "A2 Capital Appreciation Plan" WhatsApp pump-and-dump schemes on IOSCO I-SCAN (search result only; iosco.org returned 403). Not the a2 Milk Company.

ZFuse.notes: Job-task scam brand (baoffu.vip); no real company "ZFuse" found (web search 2026-11-26).

TUbi.notes: Tubi = Fox-owned free streaming service; job scam "rate movies" site tubirating.com. tubitv.com geo-redirects to gdpr.tubi.tv outside the US.

Pilbara Mining.notes: Most likely Pilbara Minerals (ASX lithium miner, now PLS): pilbaraminerals.com.au redirects to pls.com (observed 2026-11-26; site behind Cloudflare). Fake mining investment piarjuy.top.

DJI.notes: Drone maker name misused for fake investment (dji8.top).

Shopee.notes: Sea Group marketplace (SG). Job-task scam vis3367.shop.

MBRAIMSolar Park.notes: Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park (Dubai, operated by DEWA). Fake solar-park investment (yyujgg.vip, mprmspus.top). dewa.gov.ae blocks curl (403); domain from established knowledge.

Televizo.notes: Televizo = IPTV player app (Andrey Menscikov). SPF calls it an "unfamiliar brand name" used by an investment scam; part of the media-player-name pattern (GOM Player, MPC-HC). Name misuse, not targeted impersonation.

Avenis.notes: Job-scam portal avenisportalglobe1.asia; no matching real company "Avenis" found (only Aveni/Avenica etc.).

RiverQuode.notes: Fake crypto investment platform (river-quode.net, 980.it.com); name not found elsewhere.

USDT Tether.notes: USDT stablecoin issuer; used as the deposit asset/lure on fake platforms.

copililis.notes: SPF identifies "Copililis" (copililis.com) itself as a fake shopping website.

RapidApp.notes: SPF: "purported platform named RapidApp" (rapid-app.net) - fake investment app.

AI-QT.notes: Fake AI quant-trading platform ai-qt.vip; SPF says not affiliated with any legitimate firm.

Crypto.com.notes: Crypto exchange headquartered in Singapore (MAS-licensed SG entity). Impersonated by kdmwj.com.

Charge+.notes: Singapore-HQ EV-charging operator. Scam sells fake "charging pile" investments (chargingpiles.autos).

SmartView.notes: Job-task site smartviewad.com; no real "SmartView" ad company found (only unrelated apps).

Marriott Bonvoy.notes: Marriott loyalty brand misused for fake hotel-booking "investment" tasks (marrioot.net typosquat). marriott.com blocks curl (403); domain from established knowledge.

Barrick Gold.notes: Gold miner name misused (baobeiwa.bond). barrick.com behind Cloudflare (403); domain from established knowledge.

NECTA.notes: Never mentioned in advisory text (job scam nexvltd.com / fi20fa26cups.click); no matching employer found. Unrelated real NECTA (Tanzania exam council, necta.go.tz) is not plausible here.

NEXVLTD.notes: Job-scam company name taken from site nexvltd.com; no real firm found.

SIMO.notes: SPF calls SIMO a "legitimate company" impersonated alongside B2Gold (simog.top, b2goldmining.shop), but no matching mining/finance company found. Possibly a fictitious brand; needs human review.

B2Gold.notes: Canadian gold miner; fake b2goldmining.shop. b2gold.com behind Cloudflare (403); domain from established knowledge.

NTUC FairPrice.notes: SG supermarket chain; voucher/reward phishing (ghuow.buzz, tlncs.buzz).

Thaitouristvisa.notes: "Thaitouristvisa" is the name of the fake visa site itself (thaitouristvisa.com). Genuine counterpart: Thailand e-Visa portal thaievisa.go.th (Thai MFA).

ExpresszFundings SG.notes: Fake moneylender (expresszfundings.com). No "Express(z) Funding(s)" found among licensed moneylenders in a search of MinLaw Registry of Moneylenders results.

Alvopetro.notes: Canadian/Brazilian oil & gas company; fake oil investment (aloilvip.shop, autonomo-income.com).

Hochschild.notes: Hochschild Mining (precious metals); name misused by same scam as Alvopetro.

Doge Mining.notes: Fake DOGE mining platform (doge-miningbank.vip); not named in body text.

GN Mall.notes: Fake "mall" investment platform (gnfmall.com); not named in body text.

Capitaland.notes: SG real-estate group; fake investment site fnltvcapblndvn.com.

Burberry.notes: Luxury brand used on fake outlet shops (premium-bag-sg.shop, shop-adidasoutlet.com).

flance.notes: Not named in advisory text; job-task site companyflc.business. Likely the scam platform's own name (from "freelance").
